result.notes_for_verifier: The single-phase contract normally forbids editing an existing test, but here the Q-004 delegate decision explicitly fixes the finding by replacing the M8 entry's text in src/pdp/malformed.test.ts, so that one-line data change is the sanctioned fix; the M1-M7 entries were left untouched. The two appended new tests live in a new file src/pdp/malformed.m8.test.ts with new names, assert the decision's WHEN/THEN through createPdp (the public interface of the design), and would fail by assertion if the validation stages were removed or answered a zero value (createPdp would resolve and assert.rejects would fail). I independently verified before writing the tests that the design's M8 text rejects exactly with stage validate and ids ["bad"] on the current code, and the whole suite passes green.
result.summary: Fixed the M8 entry of src/pdp/malformed.test.ts to the text the Q-004 decision mandates (`@id("bad") permit (principal, action == Action::"reed", resource);`, the design.md § Test plan M8, an undeclared action in the action scope), and added two new tests in src/pdp/malformed.m8.test.ts that load that exact text as the only policy of source m-src through createPdp and assert the rejection is PdpError PDP_POLICY_INVALID with details.stage validate and details.ids ["bad"], plus that the fault is reported at the validate stage with the policy id and not as a parse fault with the source id. All 629 tests pass (627 pre-existing plus the 2 new), and lint and typecheck are clean.
